problem_type: MCP generation and project receipt state loss
symptom: Vendor validation errors remain visible after configuration changes, upstream model discovery can return only no message, video ETA is a false point estimate, model switches silently rewrite controls, export identity is incomplete, and fullscreen playback lacks the response/state evidence needed to diagnose a transient failure.
direct_cause: Renderer health snapshots are not invalidated by the catalog mutation event; model-list formatting discards status/body context; spend confirmation uses a fixed media duration; the model patch API returns only final metadata; the export artifact omits the originating job/version; and local protocol/video state is not recorded in the shared event log.
class_root: Operational facts are computed or projected at individual callers without a durable shared boundary contract for invalidation, historical aggregation, change explanation, artifact identity, and playback observation.
migration: No destructive migration. Existing event logs, export jobs, and artifacts remain readable; new ETA observations, changesets, export identity fields, and playback events are additive. Existing reference-slot and ComfyUI modality repairs are retained and receive regression evidence where already enforced.
affected_population: Users changing or deleting a vendor after a failed health check
Users discovering models through custom relays or KIE-compatible endpoints
Users confirming video generation or switching canvas models
Users querying completed production exports after the immediate toast is gone
Users encountering a transient fullscreen/local-video playback failure
entry_points: handleNomiLocalRequest and preview video event handlers
invariants: A catalog mutation invalidates affected renderer health snapshots and cannot display the old validation error as the current configuration result.
A model discovery failure carries a safe HTTP status/body summary and a next action; no result is reduced to the literal no-message placeholder.
Historical ETA uses the vendor/model/kind bucket P50/P90 and cold start is an interval, never a point estimate.
A model switch returns retained, removed, and changed-default facts alongside the final metadata patch.
A completed production export is queryable as an artifact with job identity, version, project-relative path, and run linkage.
Local protocol response status and preview video readyState/networkState are append-only project events with no secret-bearing URL payload.
residual_risks: A vendor/model bucket with no successful completed calls still uses a conservative cold-start interval.
This task does not determine the product choice for anonymous upload providers or reproduce the kling omni XML corruption report.
Instrumentation records evidence but does not assert a playback root cause.
internal_only_reason: These are Nomi-owned state, persistence, and diagnostic invariants; no external provider contract defines the local invalidation or project artifact semantics.

recurrence.reason: The same loss can recur through another vendor card, route, media kind, export invocation, or preview surface unless the shared boundary owns invalidation, aggregation, identity, and observation.
same_class_scan: Scanned all useVendorHealth callers and catalog refresh/delete/configuration paths; VendorOnboardCard, CustomVendorManage, ComfyuiLocalCard, LocalModelCard, CodexLocalImageCard, and drawer refresh converge on the catalog mutation event.
Scanned model discovery consumers; test-connection, list-models, and vendorHealth use modelListProbe, while HTTP-200 business failures are parsed by modelListResponse.

Scanned generation cost callers and model-change callers; batchPlanPreview, generationRunController, useDecomposeLayers, NodeParameterControls, and useCanvasProductionActions share spend/patch boundaries.

Scanned export and artifact writers; productionRunDriverOps is the semantic export artifact writer and productionRunService exposes the artifact query projection; localProtocol and both preview video surfaces are the active local playback paths.

generality_proof: The shared event-derived stats, invalidation event, diagnostic formatter, model changeset, production artifact write, and playback telemetry helper are consumed at the first common boundary for their class, so new callers inherit the invariant without vendor- or surface-specific branches.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Invalidate renderer health snapshots when the canonical vendor/model catalog changes.
Format and preserve safe upstream discovery diagnostics across all candidate routes.
Derive vendor/model/kind duration buckets from durable requested/completed events.
Project historical P50/P90 or cold-start interval estimates into the existing confirmation message.
Return the model-switch changeset at the same boundary that builds the final metadata patch.
Register the completed export in the durable run artifact chain.
Record the status of every project-owned local media response.
Record safe HTML video state observations through the project event bridge.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The hook clears matching snapshots, clears visible health, and forces a fresh probe on the existing catalog mutation event.
The test-connection path uses the shared upstreamErrorText formatter for status/body diagnostics.
All candidate-route HTTP and business failures pass through the same sanitized formatter.
The batch context supplies the selected vendor/model to describeGenerationCost.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: single, retry, variant, and regenerate spend confirmations
same_class_entry_points.evidence: All node-scoped cost messages use the same node-derived ETA context.
The export artifact stores the originating export job identity and version while remaining linked to the run.
Loaded metadata, can-play, and error observations go through the shared telemetry helper.
The second active preview surface uses the same telemetry helper and does not create a private event schema.

prevention.invariant: Durable requested/completed events are the only source for historical generation timing and are grouped by vendor, model, and output kind.
prevention.failure_mode: A future ETA caller cannot silently invent a per-kind point estimate when it uses the shared resolver; missing history produces an explicit interval.
prevention.strategy: Centralize event pairing, bucket derivation, quantiles, and conservative cold-start projection, then test positive, missing, and malformed event paths.

legacy_paths.rationale: The old paths are compatibility readers or existing consumers; the fixed boundaries add structured facts without leaving a second implementation or deleting user data.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency is added, upgraded, or retained for this repair.
